description:
The image depicts a brick wall with a window, and within the window there is a clock.

The clock is round and white, with black numbers and hands. It is attached to a small, wooden shelf that is propped against the window. The clock appears to be displaying the time 12:11. The brick wall is dark gray, with a small section of light-colored wood visible on the left side of the window. The window has a white frame and is set into the brick wall.
